checks.name: standalone feedback form exists, is checksummed and matches reviewed source
no pilot settings or generated Saved directory
native launcher resolves relocated files without developer tools
frozen APF starts with no installed Python or Git on PATH
frozen APF provenance matches released upstream
actual bundled APF responds to ten-aircraft protocol 2
fresh keyboard startup and profile safety
fresh writes only to explicit per-user data path
first use never invents a controller profile
package remains free of generated pilot data after execution

limitations: NullRHI with controlled game Tick intervals; not GPU frame-rate or rendering performance.
Fixed120 has ten disarmed non-autonomous aircraft and does not move PID or motor forces into the callback.
Callback dt and evolution min/max compatibility are checked; no independent integration-dt sensor.
Final positions, speed magnitude, SOC and voltage comparisons are at exported precision, not complete trajectories or current integrals.
No physical controller, other physical PC or measured airframe calibration test.
PostIntegrate synchronizes workers; elapsed wall time is not a performance comparison.
Windows UE graceful shutdown returned process code 0 for expected rejection; explicit JSON error and fingerprint are checked.
